context: Hiroshi-elder reads a newspaper crossword aloud; Sho-young helps.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: みなさん、何やと思う、この問題?
lines.en: Now then, what do you reckon this problem is?
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried opening. Warm Kansai lilt. Genuinely curious—not testing, inviting. Patient pause after the question, as if giving him room to think.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うーん、徐々に、考えてみる!
lines.en: Hmm… let me think about it gradually.
lines.style: Soft, concentrating voice. Small hesitation on the opening hum. Genuine effort—talking through his thinking process aloud, not performing. Quiet determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 読み方、難しいな、たった一行で。
lines.en: The way these characters read is tricky, isn't it—all crammed into one line.
lines.style: Affectionate observation. Kansai warmth. Not sympathetic—more like noting the puzzle alongside him. Light tone, no edge. Slight trailing-off acknowledging the genuine difficulty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah, it does take some real thinking.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Small, genuine tone—no embellishment. Direct and honest. The kind of understated observation a perceptive child makes when he's actually concentrating, not trying to impress.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 時計、見たら、随分時間経った。
lines.en: You know, I just looked at the time—quite a bit has passed.
lines.style: Soft realization. Unhurried pace. Fondness underneath—noticing the time has gone without him noticing. Gentle amusement at how absorbed they both are. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I think I might actually be able to say the answer!
lines.style: Small spark of brightness. Excited but genuine—not loud or performative. Pride in his own thinking. Voice lifts slightly, still respectful. The pleasure of breakthrough.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: There you go—you're a sharp one, aren't you!
lines.style: Warm Kansai affection. Genuine pride in him. Tender but not soft—solid, grounded warmth. The kind of praise that lands because it's earned and unguarded. Light play in the delivery.
